description.notes: The data are aggregated responses to SEC Form PF. Blank or null values are intentional to avoid potential disclosure of proprietary information of individual filers. Only responses from Qualifying Hedge Funds are included. The data are the share of hedge fund net assets that may be subjected to material restrictions on investor withdrawals (e.g., gates) based on SEC Form PF question 49(c). This relates to hedge fund advisers’ right to impose gates and not just whether gates are currently imposed. A gate is a type of redemption term that limits the amount of investor outflows allowed. By capping redemptions, gates maintain liquidity and stability within the fund. See additional definitions and methodology on the SEC Form PF Data Sets page of the Hedge Fund Monitor.
